hints.title: Translation Invariance
hints.text: Two islands have the same shape if their cell coordinates relative to the top-left starting cell of the island are identical.

hints.title: Relative Coordinate Offsets
hints.text: When discovering an unvisited land cell at (r0, c0), traverse the connected component and record each cell as (r minus r0, c minus c0).

hints.title: Canonical Signature Storage
hints.text: Collect the relative coordinate tuples for the island in a consistent traversal order. Convert the list of relative coordinates into a signature and add to a collection of distinct island shapes.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: DFS shape canonicalization relative to top-left starting coordinates.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing absolute coordinates fails because islands at different grid locations can have identical translated shapes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Normalizing each island relative to its origin enables set deduplication in O(M * N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Normalize coordinates by subtracting (r0, c0) and sort or serialize path direction strings.
